certificate.label: Certificate

fields.desc: Name or title of the certificate
Person named as the certificate recipient
Certificate or credential identifier, if stated

certificate.instructions: Extract the certificate details exactly as stated.

financial.label: Financial Statement

fields.desc: Type of financial statement or schedule
Reporting period for the line item
Name of the account, metric, or financial line item
Numeric amount as presented, preserving sign

financial.instructions: Extract each financial line item as a separate row. Preserve reported values; do not calculate or infer amounts.

research.label: Research Paper

fields.desc: Paper abstract or concise abstract summary
Main findings reported by the authors

research.instructions: Summarize only information supported by the paper. Keep author statements distinct from interpretation.

cv_data.label: CV / Resume

fields.desc: Email, phone, and location or professional links
Work experience, roles, employers, and dates

cv_data.instructions: Extract the candidate's stated information without adding inferred qualifications or dates.

custom.label: Custom
custom.instructions: Follow the user command and return the requested information.
